verdict.rationale: ADK is code-first, and it explicitly says agent logic, tools and orchestration are defined in Python for 'testability, and versioning' (gh-17). That means automations can be versioned and reviewed through ordinary source control. Its eval tooling (adk eval, test files) supports regression-style review of agent behavior. However, all of this relies on external tooling such as git, and no first-party versioning, review workflow or rollback mechanism is documented. Missing for 10: built-in version history for agents and workflows, a native review or approval flow for automation changes, any documented rollback of deployed agents, and independent corroboration.
